items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: He had two basses believe it or not, Chubby Jackson and Oscar. And that didn’t last too long because Chubby one day came to Oscar and said, “we’re going down front with our basses and we’re going to do a dance.”

ctx.x: Well at least you didn’t have to go shoot a rifle then.
No. Just for Basic Training. MR. Was Chubby Jackson on the Woody Herman band when you were there?

Yeah, he’s the one that got me on because when I had the group with Shorty Rogers he was teaching the bass player. So Chubby got me on Woody’s band. Well first he got me on Barnet’s band. That was a great band at that point. And then he said the change is © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
